description: An oak boat in a 2-deep pool, mounted with /ride: paddling forward, then with the camera turned 150 degrees off its heading (held to 105), forward turning left and right, turning on the spot both ways, backward, forward and back together, left and right together, drifting; sneaking out (onto the boat's top), in again and paddling, then quick in and out twice.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
